dossier.headline: Diwali Muhurat session ends a long winning run
dossier.summary: Analysts went into Sunday's one-hour Muhurat session expecting a positive bias, noting gains in eight of the previous 10 such sessions. The session opened firmly but gave back its early gain to close slightly lower, ending a nine-year run of Diwali-session gains. It was a thin, ceremonial trade after what reports called the biggest pre-Diwali rally in decades.
